import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_shift_forward_difference
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {h B : ℝ}
  (hh0 : 0 ≤ h) (hhB : h ≤ B)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Filter.Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  rcases hh0.eq_or_lt with rfl | hh0
  · simp only [add_zero, sub_self]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  · have H : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ c > x, 1 ≤ x → f (x + h) - f x = deriv f c * h := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 ≤ x
      · have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
        have hx_lt : x < x + h := lt_add_of_pos_right x hh0
        have h_sub : Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
          intro y hy
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx0 hy.1
        have h_cont : ContinuousOn f (Icc x (x + h)) := (hfd.mono h_sub).continuousOn
        have h_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo x (x + h)) := hfd.mono (subset_trans Ioo_subset_Icc_self h_sub)
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hcd⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx_lt h_cont h_diff
        refine ⟨c, hc.1, fun _ => ?_⟩
        have h_sub_eq : (x + h) - x = h := by ring
        rw [h_sub_eq] at hcd
        have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh0
        rw [hcd, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hh_ne]
      · exact ⟨x + 1, by linarith, fun h => (hx h).elim⟩
    choose c hc_gt hc_eq using H
    have hc_tendsto : Tendsto c atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono (fun x => (hc_gt x).le) tendsto_id
    have h_deriv_comp : Tendsto (fun x => deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 0) := hf.comp hc_tendsto
    have h_mul : Tendsto (fun x => deriv f (c x) * h) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := Tendsto.mul_const h h_deriv_comp
      rwa [zero_mul] at this
    have h_eventually : (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) =ᶠ[atTop] (fun x => deriv f (c x) * h) := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hx
      exact hc_eq x hx
    exact Tendsto.congr' h_eventually.symm h_mul

import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_shift_forward_difference
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {h B : ℝ}
  (hh0 : 0 ≤ h) (hhB : h ≤ B)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Filter.Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  by_cases hh_eq : h = 0
  · have heq : (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      ext x
      simp [hh_eq]
    rw [heq]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  · have hpos : 0 < h := lt_of_le_of_ne hh0 (Ne.symm hh_eq)
    have hBpos : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hhB
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Ioi 0) := hfd.continuousOn
    apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
    intro ε hε
    have hεB_pos : 0 < ε / B := div_pos hε hBpos
    have h_tend := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hf) (ε / B) hεB_pos
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_tend
    refine ⟨max N 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hxN : N ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left N 1) hx
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right N 1) hx
    have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hx1
    have hxh_lt : x < x + h := by linarith
    have hIcc_sub : Set.Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at hy
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]
      linarith [hy.1]
    have hIoo_sub : Set.Ioo x (x + h) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]
      linarith [hy.1]
    have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc x (x + h)) := hcont.mono hIcc_sub
    have hfd' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo x (x + h)) := hfd.mono hIoo_sub
    obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hc_eq⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hxh_lt hfc hfd'
    have hc_mem' := hc_mem
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hc_mem'
    have hc_gt : x < c := hc_mem'.1
    have hcN : N ≤ c := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hxN hc_gt)
    have h_deriv_lt_dist : dist (deriv f c) 0 < ε / B := hN c hcN
    have h_abs_deriv_lt : |deriv f c| < ε / B := by
      rwa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h_deriv_lt_dist
    have h_deriv_eq : deriv f c = (f (x + h) - f x) / h := by
      have h' := hc_eq
      have hden : x + h - x = h := by ring
      rw [hden] at h'
      exact h'
    have h_eq : f (x + h) - f x = h * deriv f c := by
      calc f (x + h) - f x = (f (x + h) - f x) / h * h := by
            rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hpos)]
        _ = deriv f c * h := by rw [← h_deriv_eq]
        _ = h * deriv f c := by ring
    have h_abs_eq : |f (x + h) - f x| = h * |deriv f c| := by
      rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hh0]
    have h_abs_lt : |f (x + h) - f x| < ε := by
      calc |f (x + h) - f x| = h * |deriv f c| := h_abs_eq
        _ ≤ B * |deriv f c| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhB (abs_nonneg _)
        _ < B * (ε / B) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_abs_deriv_lt hBpos
        _ = ε := by rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hBpos)]
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
    exact h_abs_lt
